items.description: Local path to a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP file. Relative paths resolve from the scene JSON directory.

character_description.description: Optional ASCII English description of the person. Omit or set face_description_mode to reference_only when the face references should be the source of truth.

face_reference_id.description: Backward-compatible single primary face reference path; must also occur in reference_images.

face_reference_ids.description: Optional ordered list of same-person face references from reference_images. The first path is the primary anchor; remaining paths provide additional angles.

face_description_mode.description: Use reference_only to omit potentially conflicting textual facial-shape descriptions.
